description: Train - Gare - CCPHVA is a dataset listed in Open Data CCPHVA, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CC du Pays Haut Val d'Alzette. Ce jeu de données recense toutes les gares par lesquelles passent les trains RB et RR. Carte des tracés et des gares. Coverage: Communauté de communes Portes de l'Île-de-France (Val-d'Oise). The portal files it under Mobilité Transports. Its keywords are Train. The portal shows 52 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-06-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-ccphva-portal.
